caption: Parking
explanation: Marks a parking place where you may legally leave your vehicle; check any plate beneath it for who may park, hours and time limits before you stop.
notes: Commons file page describes it as 'Parking place', a blue sign with a white 'P' (colours #01619e blue, #fff white). Verified via fetch, HTTP 200.

caption: No through road
colour: blue square, red and white T symbol
explanation: The road ahead is a dead end with no exit for vehicles, so do not use it as a through route; turn around or find another way.
mnemonic: The red bar blocks the top of the T - the road stops there.
notes: Commons page states 'No through road'; SVG palette confirmed blue #01619e, red #e31017, white #fff. Verified via fetch, HTTP 200.

caption: Hospital
colour: blue rectangle, white H and word Hospital
explanation: Points the way to a hospital ahead; this blue version has no accident and emergency department, so do not rely on it in an emergency.
notes: Commons page: 'UK traffic sign: Hospital ahead without accident and emergency facilities' - blue sign with white 'H'. Verified via fetch, HTTP 200. (Red-bordered versions exist for A&E hospitals.)

caption: Tourist information point
explanation: Directs you to a tourist information point or centre where you can pick up local maps and visitor guidance; no action is required while riding.
notes: Could NOT verify a matching 'UK_traffic_sign_<diagram>.svg' file. The UK tourist information symbol is the brown 'i' (Commons file 'UK_Tourist_Sign_T1_-_Information.svg', described as 'Tourist symbol for England and Wales: tourist Information Point or Centre', HTTP 200). It uses TSRGD symbol/diagram T1, not a numeric diagram, so it falls outside the standard naming pattern; asset points to the real available file.

caption: Entrance to a controlled parking zone
colour: white sign, blue and red symbol, CONTROLLED ZONE text
explanation: You are entering a controlled parking zone where waiting restrictions apply throughout the zone during the hours shown, so only park in marked bays and read the times.
notes: Commons page: 'UK traffic sign: 663 (TSRGDNO 663)', categorised under parking zone signs; entry sign for a controlled parking zone. White sign showing 'CONTROLLED ZONE' with a blue/red restriction symbol and operating times (SVG colours #0070ba, #dd0029). Verified via fetch, HTTP 200.

caption: End of controlled parking zone
colour: white sign, blue and red symbol, ZONE ENDS text
explanation: You are leaving the controlled parking zone, so the zone-wide waiting restrictions no longer apply, though any signed restrictions on the next road still do.
notes: Commons page: 'End of controlled or voucher parking zone (TSRGDNO 664)'. Verified via fetch, HTTP 200.

caption: Parking for solo motorcycles
explanation: The parking place shown is reserved for solo motorcycles only, so use these bays for your bike and do not park here in a car.
notes: Commons page: 'UK Traffic sign 804.4, for indicating that the parking area is reserved for solo motorcycles.' This is the supplementary plate (white motorcycle pictogram on blue) used beneath the 801 'P' sign. Verified via fetch, HTTP 200.

caption: One-way traffic
explanation: Traffic on this road flows one way only, in the direction the arrow points; continue straight ahead and expect no oncoming vehicles.
mnemonic: Straight arrow, straight ahead - one way.
notes: Commons page describes it as 'One-way traffic'. Inspected SVG: white rectangle outline over blue panel with a single white upward arrow (point at top, vertical shaft). Verified via fetch, HTTP 200. (Distinct from the red contra-flow/ahead-only regulatory arrows.)

caption: Home zone entry
colour: white sign, blue border, scene of houses, people and cyclist
explanation: You are entering a home zone designed for people as well as traffic, so drive slowly and give way to pedestrians and children who may be using the whole street.
notes: Commons page: 'Start of a designated home zone (TSRGDNO 881A)', categorised 'special regulation road signs - living street'. White sign, blue border (#1476c6), depicting houses, walking figures and a cyclist. Verified via fetch, HTTP 200. (The plain '881' filename returns 404; 881A is the actual Commons asset.)

caption: Bus lane on road at junction ahead
colour: blue rectangle, white BUSES text and road layout diagram
explanation: Warns that the road you are about to join has a bus lane crossing your path, so watch for buses before you pull out at the junction ahead.
notes: Commons page: 'Bus lane on road at junction ahead (TSRGDNO 962)'. Inspected SVG: blue panel with white 'BUSES' wording and a white road-layout diagram showing a bus lane crossing the carriageway at a junction. Verified via fetch, HTTP 200.
